task: Independent visual review of 3D short-window public-context regression captures
geometry_attribution: PNG width and height independently checked; other geometry fields retained from pinned producer metadata.
source_outcome_attribution: Outcomes above come from producer CAPTURES.json. Coordinator assigned test/source approval to pixel_d2_sea separately; this receipt makes visual findings only.

method.repeats: Independent raw-byte comparison plus SHA-256 and length equality to an original-detail direct representative.

conclusion: The baseline current-claim line is visibly clipped. Candidate captures show turn/round content in a body viewport, full card-selection controls at saved positions, and a fully visible Challenge Orbit control. The complete current-claim sentence and complete Play control are not displayed in this nine-image set, so the visual result is narrower than the separate regression test approval.

findings.observation: The baseline shows Crown table · round 4 and Your turn, while the current-claim line starts at the bottom edge and is visibly cut off. The two baseline PNGs are exact-byte duplicates.
The candidate shows a body scrollbar with Your turn and ROUND 4 beneath the persistent back/Show hand row. The Crown rank label and full claim are absent at this saved position.

Selected · Crown, Select · Moon and Select · Crown controls are fully legible in their respective captures. The Crown selected/deselected presentations differ in both wording and fill, under a visible Hide hand control. Adjacent control fragments are clipped at the lower body boundary.
Challenge Orbit is fully visible. Another control is only a bottom fragment at the top of the body; its complete label and rectangle are not visually available.
Hide last round is fully legible. ROUND 3 · PREVIOUS REVEAL begins at the lower edge and is vertically clipped; detailed historical content is not visible. This is previous-round context.

The nine captures document baseline clipping and candidate control presentations, but do not visually establish the complete current-claim sentence or a fully visible Play control. Reachability approval remains separate source/test evidence.

limits: This is a review of nine static PNG source identities only. Capture order is the source manifest order and is not an inferred timeline. No packet PTS, UTC/action alignment or continuous-privacy guarantee is assigned.
No PNG displays the complete ordinary current-claim sentence. Candidate 01-concealed displays Your turn and ROUND 4; the complete claim is outside the saved viewport.

Challenge Orbit is fully visible in candidate 03-covered-again and 04-resumed-covered. A complete readable Play control is not shown in the nine captures, so both projected actions are not visually qualified by these stills.

Drawn scrollbars and different saved content positions do not establish successful input, scrolling reachability, selection-limit enforcement, lifecycle recovery, authority acceptance, touch-target accessibility or physical-device behavior.
The selection-state captures show hand rank text under Hide hand. These are producer-labeled revealed states; their pixels do not establish cover ordering before or after input.
No 3D table geometry or card-face artwork is visible in these short-window captures. Renderer source attribution is preserved by hash; the stills alone do not qualify real 3D geometry rendering.
PNG IHDR dimensions of 389 by 215 were independently checked. Logical dimensions, density and text scale are producer metadata from the pinned input snapshot, not platform facts inferred from pixels.
No tests, builds, captures, downloads, renderer launches, original-video decodes or shared-file writes were performed. Original frozen files were rehashed after review and remain byte-identical.
